title: 8 Things Your Phone Convinces You Are More Urgent Than God
caption:
Your phone is very good at one thing: making nothing feel like an emergency.

A badge. A streak. A story about to vanish. A sale with a clock on it. None of it is actually urgent. It's built to feel that way before you've had a second to think it through.

Meanwhile the things that are actually urgent, the prayer you haven't prayed yet, the man across the table, the work sitting in front of you, don't buzz. They just wait for you to notice them.

Save this and check what's actually been running your attention today.
